# 005 · Local accuracy of the larger MobileCLIP2 models (S3, S4)

## Question
How much more accurate are MobileCLIP2-S3 and S4 than B on RefCOCOg-LPCVC, i.e. is it worth spending the remaining ~17 ms of S22 budget on a bigger model?

## Conclusions
- Larger models buy little accuracy on RefCOCOg-LPCVC. S3 is 72.11 (+0.79 vs B, paired 95% CI +0.06…+1.50, barely
  significant). S4 is 71.59 (+0.28 vs B, CI −0.49…+0.98, not significant). On the sample all three are within noise.
- S4 is not better than S3, even though it's larger. The validation accuracy is saturating at this model scale,
  so bigger pretrained models alone won't move us much further.
- S3/S4 use 768-wide text encoders (vs 512 for B/S0), so their text latency will be higher. Experiment 006 measures
  whether S3 fits the budget and how much its +0.8 points cost in ms.
- Paired deltas vs B computed from `per_image_recall.npz`; the README table shows deltas vs clip-b16.
